pi-189a034859ec440d850bb428d7618883.name: donnelly-1882.pdf
pi-189a034859ec440d850bb428d7618883.description: Donnelly's 1882 "Atlantis: The Antediluvian World" document structure, with its Preface and table of contents, which covers the case for Plato's Atlantis, flood legends, Old World and American parallels, alphabet, Bronze Age, Atlantean colonies, and a reconstruction of the lost civilization.

pi-4f34296522b74bcb9527c7b064fcf6af.name: frisch-2012-zooplankton.pdf
pi-4f34296522b74bcb9527c7b064fcf6af.description: Frisch et al. (2012) PLoS ONE study tracking zooplankton (copepods, cladocerans, rotifers) colonizing 48 newly built temporary ponds in a restored Doñana National Park wetland over 21 months, finding that connectivity, pond area, and spatial position drove colonization for copepods and cladocerans but not rotifers.

pi-4c64cee9af92415da94ba4952c56264e.name: sereno-2008-gobero.pdf
pi-4c64cee9af92415da94ba4952c56264e.description: The 2008 PLoS ONE study of Gobero, a Niger Sahara lakeside cemetery with about 200 burials, uses AMS radiocarbon and OSL dating to contrast robust early Holocene hunter-fisher-gatherers with gracile mid-Holocene successors, proposing population replacement after an arid interruption.

pi-84daae6f0ea64219a1f6e59e91b92bc1.name: snir-2015-proto-weeds.pdf
pi-84daae6f0ea64219a1f6e59e91b92bc1.description: Snir et al. (2015) PLoS ONE study of the 23,000-year-old Ohalo II hunter-gatherer camp on the Sea of Galilee, documenting ~150,000 plant remains, 13 proto-weed species mixed with wild cereal seeds, and early trial cultivation predating agriculture by about 11,000 years.

pi-9165e485de694c1d969cdea12d716d36.name: dillehay-2015-monte-verde.pdf
pi-9165e485de694c1d969cdea12d716d36.description: A 2015 PLOS ONE article reporting Monte Verde and Chinchihuapi Creek (Chile) excavation results from 2013, including ephemeral human activity dated about 18,500–14,500 cal BP on a sandur plain, along with its reference list of 53 works on the peopling of the Americas.

pi-dae72c20f8d74d439653408bfc2c783c.name: moore-2020-abu-hureyra.pdf
pi-dae72c20f8d74d439653408bfc2c783c.description: A 2020 Scientific Reports study examining Abu Hureyra, Syria, at the Younger Dryas onset (~12.8 ka), reporting high-temperature meltglass, nanodiamonds, microspherules, and elevated platinum-group elements as evidence of a cosmic airburst, with Bayesian dating, lab analyses, and a rebuttal to the opposing Thy et al. view.

pi-761085ef4ed44f87ad39f8d7f8da0d5c.name: hoffmann-2021-violence.pdf
pi-761085ef4ed44f87ad39f8d7f8da0d5c.description: Reassessment of the Late Pleistocene Jebel Sahaba Nile Valley cemetery (~13.4 ka, 61 individuals) using microscopic lesion analysis, documenting 106 new lesions, 52 projectile impact marks, and embedded Qadan lithics as evidence of recurrent interpersonal violence, compared with Nataruk and Wadi Halfa.

pi-94154f8270d54192bee4a8877425057a.name: bedmap3-2025.pdf
pi-94154f8270d54192bee4a8877425057a.description: Bedmap3 gridded dataset of Antarctic ice surface elevation, ice thickness, and bed elevation at 500 m resolution, built from 84 new aero-geophysical surveys (52 million points) plus updated grounding line, ice shelf, rock, and bathymetry data.
